correctness.rationale: The three-state Greenberg–Hastings rule on K_m joined to n independent vertices reduces exactly to 49 nonempty clique/independent color-support mask states. Support transitions are exact because all vertices of an old color in a module have identical successors. Enumeration of this finite, size-independent quotient classifies first entrance t=0..4 and eventual microscopic period 1 or 3, with period-three microscopic states even for the fixed full-support mask. Independent reconstruction checked every 49 mask state and recovered all nine monomial coefficient cells; independently iterated 3276 actual labelled vertex colorings across six graph sizes, checking mask compatibility and F^7=F^4. The uniform all-size formula follows from surjection counts onto one/two/three colors, not the bounded microscopic tests. For n=1 maximum first entrance 3, n>=2 exactly 4; m=3 is the unique nondegenerate four-way equiprobable fixed-clique limit.
